## Description

Patients can be added to a waitlist with preference (doctor, days, earliest/time window). When a slot frees (cancellation/reschedule), matching waitlist entries are highlighted with "Offer {time}". Offering sends a message; acceptance books through the normal path.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A freed slot shows matching waitlist candidates ordered by request time.
- [ ] **AC2.** "Offer" places a hold and sends a message without clinical details; if not accepted within the hold window, the next candidate can be offered.
- [ ] **AC3.** Accepting books the slot and removes the patient from the waitlist.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
